title: Choose the new MoodlIA visual world
question: Impeccable has selected a direction. Keep it, choose an alternate, or ask for a new hand.

options.label: The MoodlIA Workbench
options.lineage: precision teaching instruments and modular workshop boards
options.thesis: Three distinct instruments share one calibrated work surface, making the ecosystem tangible before it is explained.
options.viewport: A full-height work surface is divided by a monumental 3 into three live image bays; the promise and primary action sit on a compact calibration plate.
options.risk: The industrial vocabulary must stay warm and educational rather than becoming a developer console.

raised.raise: Every label and state now has operational precision without inheriting science-fiction styling.
Color commits to whole project zones instead of appearing as small decorative accents.
One continuous structural gesture carries the complete page rather than a stack of unrelated sections.
Inactive and active project states are both deliberately designed.

options.label: Campus Wayfinding
options.lineage: university wayfinding systems and screenprinted campus maps
options.thesis: MoodlIA becomes a place with three unmistakable routes and one welcoming help desk.
options.viewport: A giant route map starts at MoodlIA and splits into three color-coded destinations around concise copy and a single departure action.
options.risk: It is highly legible but more familiar and potentially more institutional than the assigned direction.

options.label: Learning Automata
options.thesis: The three project families unfold as a coordinated paper mechanism driven by one shared crank.
options.viewport: Three paper figures open in sequence around a large central crank while short labels explain the value of each movement.
options.case: Strong educator recognition and memorable motion; product scanning is slower than the workbench.
options.risk: The tactile charm could feel child-focused if the typography and mechanics lack precision.

options.label: One-bit Learning Desktop
options.thesis: Each MoodlIA way opens as a crisp tool window on one shared black-and-white desktop.
options.viewport: Three overlapping windows reveal AI integration, teaching tools, and insights with a persistent help menu.
options.case: Excellent product clarity and open-source character; weaker identification for non-technical educators.
options.risk: The interface can read as retro novelty unless every pixel and interaction is disciplined.

options.label: Operations Terminal
options.thesis: MoodlIA behaves like a mission terminal with three operational commands.
options.viewport: A single command line reveals the three ways as typed operational pages.
options.case: Strong operational grammar but directly conflicts with the non-technical audience.
options.kept: Operational precision for labels, state, and feedback.
options.risk: It would position MoodlIA as a developer tool rather than an educator ecosystem.

options.label: Open Learning Fair
options.thesis: The ecosystem becomes a vivid public event where every project has a loud invitation.
options.viewport: A full-bleed collage carries one enormous multicolor word and one calm white project finder.
options.case: High attention but insufficient calm and clarity for choosing practical Moodle tools.
options.kept: Color must own full regions instead of appearing as timid accent decoration.
options.risk: The promotional energy could obscure the three-way model.

options.label: Folded Learning Map
options.thesis: One continuous fold raises three useful surfaces from a single MoodlIA sheet.
options.viewport: A monumental paper disc bends into three labeled planes around a restrained introduction.
options.case: Beautiful ecosystem metaphor but slow to explain concrete projects.
options.kept: One structural gesture should organize the complete experience.
options.risk: The sculptural abstraction could hide the product offer.

options.label: Three Signals
options.thesis: The ecosystem is reduced to three synchronized signals that switch from waiting to useful.
options.viewport: A fixed mask shows a giant 3 and three product readings whose segments ignite as visitors move through them.
options.case: Memorable states but too numerical for a broad teaching audience.
options.kept: Inactive states receive as much design attention as active ones.
options.risk: The signal language would reduce nuanced project differences to a gimmick.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A polished education-technology landing page with a conventional hero and three product cards.
canonCard.viewport: A left-aligned promise, an image mosaic, and three familiar solution cards below it.
canonCard.risk: Clear and dependable, but intentionally difficult to distinguish from other software suites.
